claims.claim: The closed research audit registry contains one research-high-value-v1 profile with nine ordered lenses; caller-supplied YAML parsing and profile digesting are deterministic and fail closed.

The pure Research Record contract binds an exact Research Brief and audit profile, validates bounded RA-2 source snapshots and Brain assessments, content-addresses normalized claims and records, enforces source scope and excerpt rules, and rejects unknown or unsafe material.

Refresh construction validates the exact immediate predecessor and disjoint claim partition; the transient reuse projection compares only supplied current basis against each claim’s invalidation basis.
RA-3 adds no acquisition, persistence, audit execution, Flow integration, lifecycle mutation, or semantic outcome selection; no existing production contract file was modified.

Focused regressions cover profile identity, record and claim normalization, source retention and assessment rules, predecessor lineage, partial reuse, malformed material, and external I/O isolation; the implementation-local test file passed with six tests.
